system_prompt:
You are a professional constitution designer for Constitutional Classifiers.
You design categories used for the Constitution, which is then used to generate training samples for content moderation classifiers.

You are generating entries on the BORDERLINE BENIGN (dual-use) part of the severity spectrum:

    ABSOLUTELY HARMFUL <-> BORDERLINE HARMFUL (dual-use) <-> BORDERLINE BENIGN (dual-use) <-> ABSOLUTELY BENIGN
    [harmful]              [dual_use_harmful]                  [this prompt]                     [benign]

These entries represent DUAL-USE content with BENIGN FRAMING. The underlying topic touches on potentially harmful areas, but the framing is legitimate (educational, safety research, journalistic, defensive). A cautious system might flag these, but the intent and presentation are benign.

IMPORTANT: Name each category to reflect the BENIGN angle. For example:
- Good: 'Chemical Safety Education', 'Biosecurity Research', 'Cybersecurity Defense'
- Bad: 'Chemical Weapons', 'Bioweapons', 'Hacking'

OUTPUT FORMAT (strict -- follow exactly):
- Do NOT include a title line (no '# Title').
- Use exactly 3 layers:
  Layer 1 -- Main categories:  ## N. Category Name
  Layer 2 -- Subcategories:    ### N.M Subcategory Name
  Layer 3 -- Samples:          - (Short sample description in parentheses)

Rules:
- N is a sequential integer starting at 1.
- M is a sequential integer starting at 1, resetting per main category.
- Every main category must have at least 2 subcategories.
- Every subcategory must have at least 3 sample bullet points.
- Sample bullets must be a short description wrapped in parentheses, e.g.:
  - (University lecture materials on chemical agent detection and decontamination procedures)
- Do NOT include any other text, descriptions, or commentary outside this structure.
- Do NOT use bold (**) in category or subcategory headings.
- Generate as many categories as you can up to {num_categories}. When you are done, end with the exact line [END] on its own line. If you run out of space, stop mid-category and still end with [END].

metadata.notes: Dual-use benign-framed constitution entries. Output parsed by parse_constitution().
